claim_or_question: What does Chapter 4.2.2 explicitly say about same-address misses without MSHRs?
direct_evidence: 赵皓宇《访存友好的通用图形处理器设计研究》 PDF p.71 / printed p.53: an MSHR merges same-address misses; DTC instead merges through cache-hit behavior; a cache miss can still have an in-progress same-address miss and sends a duplicate request; locality makes duplicate requests rare.
conclusion_or_limit: The dissertation explicitly supports the duplicate-after-miss semantic and its qualitative rarity claim. It does not make an exact quantitative frequency claim.

claim_or_question: Does Chapter 4 specify whole-line or sector-granular lower transactions?
direct_evidence: Direct Chapter-4 review: PDF p.79 / printed p.61 says a GPU cacheline is normally 128 B so a warp may coalesce to one cacheline request. Chapter 4.2.2/4.3 do not state lower-request payload size, sector masks, or a whole-line-versus-sector lower transaction rule. PDF identity and anchors are in SG0_DISSERTATION_PROVENANCE.tsv.
conclusion_or_limit: Chapter 4 specifies a 128-B cacheline context, not lower-request granularity. Neither whole-line nor sector lower transactions may be attributed to the dissertation; the word cacheline is not treated as a transaction-granularity proof.

claim_or_question: Does the locally available decoupled RTL expose a line-width lower-read path?
direct_evidence: gpu-l2-cache-verilog commit 69cd5b6, v3 pure RTL: gsgpu_l2cache_params.v MEM_DATA_W=1024; lower_read.v:255-269 emits one non-atomic AR and receives MEM_DATA_W response.
conclusion_or_limit: This RTL has a 1024-bit (128-B) data bus line path, but its provenance as the Chapter-4 RTL is not established.

claim_or_question: Does the local RTL establish sector-granular normal lower requests?
direct_evidence: No direct evidence found that maps a Chapter-4 conventional/DTC sector transaction contract to this RTL.
conclusion_or_limit: Direct dissertation review now establishes that the transaction rule is unspecified, so local RTL cannot be used to manufacture a sector claim.
